notes.title: Version 25.5: "Stable Economy"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/3dfc3625259517d05d81dc6c23a776f619ab6969.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]FEATURES AND MAJOR UPDATES[/b][/h1]

[h1]Stability[/h1]
This mini-patch is for stability in the client, as we move forward, we want to keep delivering on bug fixes and crashes, Our next goal over the few months is mainly delivering a bug-free experience with BCO.

[h1]Economy[/h1]
As announced previously, in this update we have removed the ability to purchase Fighters with the in-game currency “Runes”. From now on, players will receive two free fighters for completing the in-game tutorial. All players with older accounts are invited to claim this bonus as well. Additional fighters can be purchased as DLC in steam, or directly in-game via in-app purchases. We will introduce new uses for the in-game currency shortly in an upcoming patch. Please look out for these exciting new additions to BattleCON Online soon!

[h1]Indines Cup[/h1]
The first official BattleCON Online Tournament is still underway currently!

[h1][b]MINOR NOTES AND BUGFIXES[/b][/h1]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]We fixed options in replay mode freezing when paused.
[*]When you find an opponent but the game doesnt load correctly, it will now request if it needs to fix this and will kick you out of the game automatically, and re-que you.
[*]We have fixed a crash on the purchase screen.
[*]When bug reporting at the end of the game, it does not exit you from main menu if you click.
[*]Evil Hikaru now say's the correct finisher lines.
[/list]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*]DLC Packs for fighters - Season 1 and Season 2.
[*]Added Input saving on the client, so we can replay them if a game needs it.
[*]Added a new server message to tell the client, why the game is stuck and how to resolve.\
[*]A polling system for products, which fixes when you login into the game, and all your characters are greyed out, It will now try and force it to un-grey and unlock all your characters.
[*]Fallback system for speech bubbles if they are stuck after 3 seconds they will disappear.
[*]More error checking for when you leave a Que.
[/list]
[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Optimized the main menu fighter selection faces a bit more, so they load much faster when coming back from a game now.
[*]Win rates will only be able to been seen after 15 wins with the fighter.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.25: "Download."
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/dd36fc5404645039d8725f661373aaae7f1de53f.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]FEATURES AND MAJOR UPDATES[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/d82ff19a7b1c94c3b8e8df9b495032db4f5cd1b6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Advanced Replay Controls[/h1]
This has been one of the most anticipated request. In a replay, you now have the control to pause the replay instantly. You can also control the replay's playback speed. Check out these features by loading-up a replay!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/0e7425c639a795fbf465b3cf996b133b5c010125.jpg[/img]

[h1]Indines Cup[/h1]
The first official BattleCON Online Tournament is here! Test your mettle in this fight of the ages! Find out more by clicking the "Signup" button in the main menu.

http://tiny.cc/Indines-Cup-Signup

[h1][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h1]
With each patch, we are constantly updating the balance and playability of fighters in BattleCON Online.

[h1]Kimbhe:[/h1]
[b]Expulsion: [/b]Can place staff in occupied space (revert of old change).

While the Expulsion change had the right power level effect, many players felt that it made Kimbhe less fun to play. We'll continue to monitor her power level to see if a compensation nerf elsewhere is needed, but you can once again regain the staff with Expulsion.

[h1]Kehrolyn:[/h1]
[b]Hydra Fork:[/b] After Activating heal reduced from 5 to 3

Hydra Fork is probably the best finisher in the game at the moment, and a lot of that is how reliable the heal is on a meaty Stun Immune attack. Reducing it to 9 effective Power should make it a bit more reasonable to play against for opponents that manage to dodge the Fork.

[h1][b]MAJOR NOTE[/b][/h1]
Next patch, we will be overhauling the economy for runes and coins. This means potentially having fighters only purchasable via coins or as DLC. Runes will remain, however, and you will be able to spend them on a new feature. This is an early warning for those sitting on runes, we highly recommend that you buy your fighters now! This may apply to avatars in the shop as well.

[h1][b]MINOR NOTES AND BUGFIXES[/b][/h1]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Opening the Request bar in game should no longer crash the game.
[*]Getting a packet error now checks whether the error is game-related before kicking you back to the main menu.
[*]Marmelee's music should no longer load into RAM, increasing speed.
[/list]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*]Remaining Elite Skin Avatars are now in-game.
[/list]
[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bundles have been removed from the in-game store.
[/list]

Ranked Mode is now enabled! Duke it out and rank up to see yourself rise on the leaderboards. You’ll also see your rank reflected on your avatar with a special border based on how far you’ve gotten. Go to “Ranked Play” to rank up and see the leaderboard.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/a63e3467b593ad5f95bbe13b942fa3b675d4777c.png[/img]

[h1Character Select UI Update[/h1]
We have fixed the character select screen so that all the fighters appear on one page. It will now be easier to select your main if you love Shekhtur or Seven! See the change on the fighter select screen.

[h1Character Select UI Update[/h1]
We have fixed the character select screen so that all the fighters appear on one page. It will now be easier to select your main if you love Shekhtur or Seven! See the change on the fighter select screen.

You can now reroll a quest you don’t like once a day. No longer will you be stuck with a “Play Heavy” quest when you don’t want to play Heavies. Simply open your quest panel and click the reroll!

[/list]

[list]

[*]Avatars should now have borders indicating a player’s rank.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Quick Play removed and replaced with Ranked Play.
[*]Win/loss ratio no longer appears on the loading screen before a match.

notes.title: Version 0.21: Kehrolyn shifts into play
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/ce374cb2866c458256afb27c234416b3b5194082.jpg[/img]

[b]Welcome to BATTLECON ONLINE early access version 0.21.0[/b]
[i]Released on March 6, 2019[/i]

[h1][b]NEW RELEASES[/b][/h1]

[h1]New Fighter: Kehrolyn[/h1]
 A shapeshifting experiment, Kehrolyn uses her adaptive forms to compound stats and effects, overwhelming her opponents! Available in the in-game store for 450 coins (or 1500 runes). Season 2 Pass holders have automatically received this new fighter.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/5490b1fdb30215af9b22e71816566534afa0aafb.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]FEATURES AND MAJOR UPDATES[/b][/h1]

[h1]Tutorial Update[/h1]
We’ve streamlined the tutorial and also take the time to explain some of the UI elements in the game. Access the new tutorial by clicking the “How To Play” button in character select!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/92ee76b9a33c06c90af79b9e896b032307c8e3a5.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h1]

With each patch, we are constantly updating the balance and playability of fighters in BattleCON Online. Here are recent changes by our developers intended to improve the balance and competitive meta of BattleCON Online.

[h1]Seven[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Undaunted[/b]: Now always Advances 1, 2, or 3; now gives opponents at Range 3+ Power -2
[*][b]Friendly[/b]: Now heals 2 if opponent was hit but not stunned.
[*][b]Heated[/b]: Now has +3 Power, from +2.
[*][b]Excited[/b]: Now has +0 Power, from -1.
[*][b]Sympathetic[/b]: Now Advances 1, 2, or 3, from 1 or 2.
[*][b]Reciprocate[/b]: Now has Soak 2; Range to 1~3 from 1~6.
[*][b]With Feeling[/b]: Stats to 4~6/3/6 with Soak 3. Still upgrades all Styles. Follow-up work to be performed next patch.
[/list]
[i]Seven has been under-performing in match-ups against rangers and some major heavyweights. These should amplify her trading and late-game abilities, while Undaunted change gives her a one-shot damage reduction against rangers paired with some hit confirm.[/i]


[h1][b]MINOR NOTES AND BUGFIXES[/b][/h1]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hovering on an ante while it was disappearing no longer causes desyncs
[*]Eligor and Khadath’s achievements now work properly
[*]Newer player matchmaking
[/list]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*]New set of achievements for some of the characters. Enjoy figuring them out!
[*]New zen garden arena background for tutorial and practice modes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.19: Meet Irialandradayamorella!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/dd0579ecac0d16a207bd9083071ccb1098b1acc7.jpg[/img]

[b]Welcome to BATTLECON ONLINE version 0.19.0[/b]
[i]Released on December 19, 2018[/i]

[h1][b]NEW RELEASES[/b][/h1]

[h1]New Fighter: Iri[/h1]
A Magical Girl from Space who transforms into 3 different forms to adapt to any situation! Available in the in-game store for 450 BattleCOINs (or 1500 Runes). Season 2 Pass holders have automatically received this new fighter.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/b6718e964f8ea9f0a69b3b6d18e7fa08c733d0cc.png[/img]

[h1][b]FEATURES AND MAJOR UPDATES[/b][/h1]

[h1]Avatar Shop[/h1]
A new section of the shop is open! The Avatar Shop lets you buy different avatars to customize your profile and show your style! Simply click the “Avatars” tab in the shop to see what you can buy.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/07e6c80dfe8169851f65ffc709ba1a670c42d683.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tooltips[/h1]
Keywords and effects are now explained in-game. This should make it easier to remember what everything does. Just mouse-over the cards in-game to see their tooltips.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/e4113a1eec1ebbacc7f49ec68cb0346a8b611a13.png[/img]

[h1][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h1]

[h1]Burman[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Blistering[/b]: Now has 1 Power, from 2
[*][b]Dragonbreath[/b]: Now has 1 Power, from 0. Now has "Start: You may spend 2 Firepower to deal 2 life loss the first time opponent Advances this beat." instead of its previous On Hit
[*][b]Dragon's Descent[/b]: Now has 7 Power, from 8. Now has 1 Priority, from 2
[/list]
[i]This should flatten Burman's power curve somewhat rather than just making him constantly rely on Blistering as the key trading/beat-winning tool. In return, Dragonbreath becomes a lot more favorable at midrange while also giving him a powerful tool to punish predictable advances..[/i]

[h1]Magdelina[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]UA[/b]: Now loses Trance equal to Level when leveling up (or hitting Level
[*]  Cap), instead of all Trance
[/list]
[i]One really awkward thing about Magdelina was that Blessing was often useless for gaining Trance, because she would lose the bonus counter if it was used too close to her leveling up. This should open up a lot more opportunities for her to play Blessing during the game. Her actual level up rate is unchanged, outside of Blessing situations.[/i]

[h1]Kimbhe[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Expulsion[/b]: Now specifies Staff -may- be moved to -unoccupied- space.
[*][b]Quake[/b]: Stun guard to 3 from 4
[/list]
[i]Right now, Expulsion Caster and Expulsion Dodge make it too easy for Kimbhe to regain her Staff, essentially wiping out a lot of potential staff control the opponent could play. This should make her work a bit harder to get that constant +2 Power, and limit her ability to easily close games with Quickening's +4 Priority.[/i]

[h1]Sarafina[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Tactical[/b]: Now has Hit: You may spend 2 Force for +1 Power
[*][b]Locus[/b]: Now has Start: If the opponent is on your Projection, Gain 2 Force and Pull 1
[*][b]Field[/b]: Now has Hit: Gain 2 Force in addition to immobilizing opponent
[*][b]Hollow[/b]: Now has Damage: Gain 1 Force
[*][b]Silver[/b]: Now has -1 Power, +1 Priority
[*][b]Fulminating Vortex[/b]: Now has 7 Power, from 8
[*][b]Ritherwhyte Infusion[/b]: Now has Hit: Gain 2 Life
[/list]
[i]Tactical, despite having good stats, tended to be underwhelming. Part of this is the amount of power wrapped up in Silver/Implosion at the moment, and part of it is the fact Sarafina never really went in for big damage spikes. These changes give her more resources to play with in terms of cashing out Force for Power as a way to get riskier, more interesting damage as well as generally tapping up her power level.[/i]
 
[h1]Seven[/h1]
[list]
[*] Cold: Now has +0~1 Range
[*] Remote: Now has After: Advance up to 1
[/list]
[i]These should make Seven's early-game a little less rough, given how risky her Ranges tend to be at the moment (how easily she can lock herself out of being able to hit). Heated was way better than Cold, so this should help Cold look a bit better in comparison too![/i]


[h1][b]MINOR NOTES AND BUGFIXES[/b][/h1]

[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved disconnect detection
[*]Linux and Mac now run on 2k textures
[*]How textures are assorted for better performance
[*]Internal game engine to support latest features
[*]Punctuation for one of Mikhail’s voice lines
[*]Discard pile support
[*]99% of how Friends Lists work for a more optimized solution
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]A bug where your shop would crash from irrelevant data
[*]A crash in tutorial 3
[*]Force gauge animation broken in some cases
[*]Mikhail’s voice line not playing properly
[*]Game's icon and title being incorrect
[*]Game getting stuck on login for some people
[*]Non-attacking finishers causing the character to say their voices lines the following beat
[/list]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*]Instant status reporting for friends list
[*]Better support from undefined crashes
[*]A fix for viewing different shops in different builds
[*]A whole new animated background for the holiday season
[*]Profile caching for faster load times for friends and opponents
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.18 is here! Evil Hikaru is now available to all players!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33231895/7a6a45cf54dec6c4ab3901535e2e6b216b6a7f82.jpg[/img]
[b]Welcome to Patch 0.18! [/b]
This is a small one, with a bunch of bugfixes and the release of our next character: Evil Hikaru! Kickstarter backers have been able to play him for a bit, but now everyone can go at it!

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Evil Hikaru is now available for all players as a purchasable fighter.
[*] Evil Hikaru's listed difficulty updated to 4, from 3.
[*] Cesar's listed difficulty updated to 3, from 2.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes:[/h1]

[b]Evil Hikaru:[/b]

[list]
[*] Pure Evil - Power raised from -1 to +0. [i]Pure Evil is Evil Hikaru's hardest Style to use due to lack of defenses and low Priority; this should help put the reward in line with the risk.[/i]
[*] Devastator now hits at Range 4 if the Power debuff does not apply (at 2 or fewer tokens). [i]Evil Hikaru's ranges are... spotty at best, and he's particularly weak when at range. Devastator is a hard Base to use due to its movement issues, but this should give him an interesting ranged option that he needs to work for.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Other Bugfixes and Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added: X-Range / Special Ranges now show an effect pop-up on hit to clarify that they landed a hit through special effects instead of normal range calculation.
[*] Fixed: (Burman) Dragon's Descent dodge effect did not activate properly.
[*] Fixed: Hail the King, Aegis, Sweet Revenge now gain Power properly when interacting with Blessing.
[*] Updated: Seven's card evolutions were changed from End: timing to Recycle: timing.
[*] Fixed: Evil Hikaru regain life bug with Finisher.
[*] Fixed: Alexian's Mighty style affecting Finishers.
[*] Fixed: At 5 clashes, the game will trigger "Auto Cleanup" to clean all statuses.
[*] Fixed: Bug that caused some fighters to say Finisher voice lines during regular attacks.
[*] Fixed: A bug on Mac and Linux where the card name color was grey, but was meant to be an non-grey color.
[*] Fixed: A glitch with force effect in the UI.
[*] Changed: How ping system works for better Disconnect detection.
[*] Fixed: Disconnection message will no longer pop up while trying to authenticate if you take too long.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.17: Burman arrives
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to BATTLECON ONLINE version 0.17.0[/b]
[i]Released on October 3rd, 2018[/i]

This may be a light update, but it still has a heavy hitter—say hello to [b]Burman[/b]!

A powerful specialist/heavyweight, Larimore Burman can save up Power and Priority to unleash devastating attacks that force the opponent across the board, shred their defenses, or overwhelm their Priority instantly. 

[h1][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h1]

[h1]Hikaru[/h1]
[b]Sweeping now has Damage: Advance 1 or 2.[/b]
[i]Sweeping has always felt a bit underpowered when not used with Dodge or to end games with Fire. This gives it a touch more versatility and lets Hikaru threaten a quick duck in against some ranged characters when combined with Water.[/i]

[h1]Rukyuk[/h1]
[b]Trick now has End, Range 1: Retreat up to 1.[/b]
[i]Trick is okay, but Stun Immunity alone made it a fairly uninteresting Style. Giving Rukyuk a slight disengage should help his game against his worst matchups while not changing those where he can keep range easily.[/i]

[h1]Sarafina[/h1]
[b]Hollow's Range 3 effect now also Ignores Soak.[/b]
[i]We heard a lot of feedback that Sarafina had particular trouble against heavyweights. This should give her a solid tool if she can maintain the specific range against Soak-heavy plays.[/i]

[h1][b]CLIENT UPDATES[/b][/h1]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Friends matches
[*]Miscellaneous small bugs
[/list]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*]Burman Imagery and Voice Acting
[*]Code redemption
[/list]
[b]Updated:[/b]
[list]
[*]Login system
[*]Packet system
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.16 is here! Improved login flow and visual clarity
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to BATTLECON ONLINE version 0.16.0[/b]

Released on September 19th, 2018

[h1]Updates[/h1]This patch is all about visuals and code upgrades! We've looked at a lot of feedback from our players, and we've made a number of major changes. Evil Hikaru should be coming up soon, so hold tight and enjoy the upgrades until then!

[list]
[*]Login should be a lot easier! If you want to register an account it's similar, but you can jump in and play even without it. This should make things a lot more user-friendly when trying to register initially.
[*]Unique Ability (UA) cards are updated! People wanted more information about how UAs work in detail, so we've added illustrated cards in-game that should help explain!
[*]Pop-ups and visuals added on a number of cards. These should clarify situations where you need to see what a token does, or otherwise interact with things that were hard to find!
[*]Flip Viewer and Help Overlay! Press the ? button in-game to see a summary of what everything is on the screen, or click the flip arrow on Kallistar and Seven's cards to see what both sides of the card do. 
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[h1]Luc: [/h1]
[b]Memento token cost increased from 2 to 3.[/b]
[i]Memento is Luc's best punish, and the ability to swing for 6 on Memento Shot or Memento Drive is a huge threat that represents his most efficient cash-out on Time. This should tax his resources a touch more, while better normalizing the value of Time at 1 effective Power.[/i]

[h1]Kallistar: [/h1]
[b]Elemental Ignition's life cost reduced from 3 to 2.[/b]
[i]Elemental Ignition is pretty risky, in general. This makes both powered-up cards cost a total of 3 life and slightly reduces the risk.[/i] 

[h1]Visual Changes and Upgrades[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Kallistar:[/b] Life loss now occurs before pairs are set, for consistency with Finisher costing. 

[*][b]Karin:[/b] Full Moon's passive "+2 Power if Jager behind opponent" refactored into a Hit effect for clarity.

[*][b]Eligor, Alexian, Seven, Cesar:[/b] "Ignore push or pull" effects (Vengeful, Gestalt, Terrified) now have a Reveal trigger popping up the effect, for clarity purposes.

[*][b]Khadath:[/b] Snare now pops up a Reveal: trigger stating "your trap cannot be moved" if you used it with Teleport, Blight, or Evacuation.

[*][b]Hikaru:[/b] Added reminder text to token regains to clarify what regained tokens do. Fixed some voice lines.

[*][b]Rukyuk:[/b]Added reminder text to Ammo spends to clarify what spent tokens do.

[*][b]Hikaru, Riflam, Rukyuk:[/b] Effects interacting with a single custom token (Geomantic, Substantial, Crossfire, etc.) now use the art of that token instead of the card's art.

[*][b]Sarafina, Khadath, Kimbhe:[/b] Standardized wording between X-range marker-based Unique Bases.

[*][b]Cesar:[/b] Cesar's UA better explains Threat Level bonuses at the start of each beat.

[*][b]Magdelina:[/b] Fixed bug where Solar Soul could not spend Trance for buffs.

[*][b]Mikhail:[/b] Switch now clarifies that Mikhail does not need to spend a Seal.Fixed some voice lines.

[*][b]Sarafina:[/b] Fixed a bug where Field could sometimes hit opponents on Space 1.

[*][b]Anath:[/b] Fixed bug with Dark Revulsion crashing while negating range. Fixed bug with Dark Revulsion using up Cesar's extra life.
[/list]

[h1]Client Changes/Updates[/h1]

[list]
[*]FIXED: Tutorial is now skippable.
[*]CHANGED: Removed lock image from unlocked fighters.
[*]FIXED: Cursor was being displayed underneath dialog boxes in some situations.
[*]CHANGED: Friends status timer updated.
[*]ADDED: Added access to DEV Server.
[*]FIXED: Tutorial not working on mac and linux.
[*]ADDED: Added all new UA frames/descriptions to fighters.
[*]ADDED: Bundles to the store.
[*]ADDED: Unlock Icon added back in.
[*]ADDED: Staggered reconnection attempts.
[*]FIXED: Mac - Force particle effects never disapear.
[*]FIXED: Mac - Dust clouds lasting a long time on movement and attack.
[*]FIXED: Mac - EXP and Levels Displaying incorrectly.
[*]ADDED: A redeem code button in the shop.
[*]ADDED: A Help overlay in game.
[*]CHANGED: Abilities tab to show UA Frame.
[*]FIXED: Packet 2022 Error crash.
[*]ADDED: A Stun Guard cap to 99.
[*]ADDED: The letters "SI" for when your pair has Stun Immunity.
[*]ADDED: Clicking on the small arrow  on a card (on a card that can transform) in-game will show what it will transform into.
[*]FIXED: Failed to send packet stalling some games. Packet failures should now resolve more cleanly.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to BattleCON Online -- All Fighters Unlocked this week
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

[b]Thanks so much for participating in the launch of BattleCON Online in Steam Early Access![/b]

During this week, [b]all fighters are free to play[/b] [i](those open locks next to the fighters on the select screen mean they are un-locked as part of this week's free rotation)[/i]. After the week ends, we'll return to our normal 4-fighters-per-week free rotation.

We've had a few rough moments with the server, but things have stabilized now. We are actively tracking bugs reported in the forums and in-game. We are also working on additional user interface improvements, updates to tutorials, game effect clarity, and the stability of our servers.

If you wish to report bugs or make suggestions for future improvements to the game, please use the in-game bug report feature (in the bottom left corner of the interface, the bug icon) or use our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflYNvvxsrvqvGe94nDiOOOtOQ4yKpBv0qd0XvBFf6fM0TDfw/viewform?usp=sf_link]Bug Report + Suggestions Form[/url].

Once again, thanks so much for taking the time to play and help us improve our first digital offering! We appreciate your support and encouragement as we continue working to build the best BattleCON Online possible!

- D. Brad Talton Jr, Level 99 Games
